data.long_meaning: The name Melvyn is of Old English origin, derived from 'Mel' meaning friend and 'win' meaning king. The name Melvyn is a compound name, meaning 'friend of the king'. This name has been used in English speaking countries since ancient times. The name Melvyn carries the meaning “Friend of the king” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melvyn usually hope their child will grow to embody friend of the king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
